rationale: Price is at 90% of today's range and pressing against the session high ($54.63) after a strong intraday recovery from the gap-down open, but the last five 1-minute candles show stalling momentum with declining volume and price unable to break above $54.60 — suggesting exhaustion near resistance rather than a clean breakout.
